visual_goal: Show a finance application's lifecycle as a path of states that continues long after users stop using it, ending only when its records leave retention.
prompt: A left-to-right path of eight rounded stepping stones across a wide landscape, connected by short arrows: 'Planned', 'Phasing in', 'Active', 'Phasing out', 'Retiring', 'Decommissioned', 'Archive only', 'Destroyed'. Small unlabeled generic people figures stand on and around the first three stones, busiest at 'Active'; from 'Phasing out' onwards the stones are empty of people. The five stones after 'Active' sit inside one long soft orange highlighted band. Small icons sit beside the later stones: a closing door at 'Phasing out', a lock at 'Retiring', a folder of papers at 'Decommissioned', an archive box with a small stopwatch at 'Archive only', and a shredder at 'Destroyed'. Exactly seven arrows.
alt: A path of eight lifecycle states from Planned through Active to Destroyed; people use the system only up to Active, and the long highlighted stretch afterwards — phasing out, retiring, decommissioned, archive only — ends only when the records are destroyed.

visual_goal: Show the portfolio as a pipeline from reconciled external sources to evidenced retirements, with evidence flowing back into the fact base and savings into the benefits register.
prompt: A left-to-right pipeline illustration. At the far left, six small plain source icons stacked vertically (a key, a coin, a shield, a plug, a map pin, a cloud), each with a thin arrow into a large funnel labeled 'Fact base'. Exactly two arrows leave the narrow end of the funnel: the upper one into a box 'Scoring', which has one arrow into a box 'TIME disposition'; the lower one into a box 'TCO model'. A box 'Wave plan' receives exactly three arrows: one from 'TIME disposition', one from 'TCO model', and one from a small calendar labeled 'Renewals' below it. Next, a stack of documents labeled 'Decision records' with one arrow from 'Wave plan'. Next, a box 'Sunset' with one arrow from 'Decision records'. At the far right, on the same row as 'Sunset', an open ledger book labeled 'Benefits register' with a stack of coins; one horizontal arrow goes from 'Sunset' right into it. A second arrow starts at the bottom edge of the 'Sunset' box itself, drops straight down, then runs left along the bottom of the picture back into the funnel; a folder labeled 'Evidence pack' sits on this return arrow. Nothing connects the ledger book to the return arrow.
alt: Six external sources feed a fact base, which drives scoring, TIME disposition and a TCO model into a wave plan paced by renewals, then decision records and sunsets; each sunset returns an evidence pack to the fact base and realized savings to the benefits register.

visual_goal: Show finance applications in three pace layers: fast-changing differentiating systems feed slow, controlled systems of record through a stable event contract.
prompt: A top-to-bottom illustration of three stacked horizontal layers, like strata. Top layer, thin and light green, labeled 'Systems of Innovation', with small sprouting seedlings and flasks. Middle layer, teal, labeled 'Systems of Differentiation', with several small fast-spinning gears and motion lines. Bottom layer, thick and deep blue, labeled 'Systems of Record', with a few large heavy slow gears and an open book. One arrow down from the top layer into the middle layer labeled 'Proven ideas'. Between the middle and bottom layers, a solid flat steel plate spans the full width, and one arrow passes down through a single gate in the plate, labeled 'Canonical events'. Exactly two arrows.
alt: Three stacked layers: innovation on top, fast-changing differentiation in the middle, and slow, heavy systems of record at the bottom; proven ideas move down, and differentiating systems reach the systems of record only through a single canonical-events gate.
